mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong growth signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies invest in growth initiatives.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite tight labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising Real Personal Savings (RSAFS) indicates consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window for this always-on signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 110, coupled with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 210), indicates a supply-side driven growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite supply-side growth signals.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 3-month decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points signals an emergency monetary response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite emergency rate cuts.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window for this always-on signal.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in GDP Growth Rate (GDPC1) below 2%, coupled with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5%), indicates a looming recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite recessionary signals.
